captions.detailed: A desk-size box fan consisting of a square grey housing with a perforated white front grille, mounted on a horizontal tilt base. Inside the housing, a multi-blade dark blue fan assembly is visible. The fan housing can tilt up and down on a horizontal revolute joint relative to its base, the fan blades can spin continuously on their motor shaft, and a black control knob on the side panel can rotate continuously on its axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a square box fan with a horizontal tilt base. The fan housing should be capable of tilting on a revolute joint relative to the base, the inner fan blades should spin continuously on a central axis, and a side-mounted control knob should rotate on its shaft.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining three main articulated parts: a base, a housing, and a rotor assembly. The base is built using a flat rectangular box and two vertical support arms. The housing is constructed as a hollowed-out box with a perforated pattern of hexagonal holes on its front face, and is connected to the base via a revolute joint. The rotor assembly, consisting of a central hub and multiple angled blades, is placed inside the housing and connected via a continuous joint to simulate rotation.
